as ''Tiras Tiraspol''}} | nickname = {{unbulleted list|{{nowrap|''Zholto-Chornyye'' (The Yellow-Blacks)}}|''Osy'' (The Wasps)}} | ground = [[Sheriff Arena]] | capacity = 12,746{{cite news|url=http://sheriff-sport.com/main-arena/| archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/20210929/http://sheriff-sport.com/main-arena/| archive-date=29 September 2021|title=Stadium capacity}}{{cbignore}}sheriff-sport.com | owner = [[Sheriff (company)|Sheriff]] | chrtitle = President | chairman = [[Viktor Gushan]] | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Miodrag Džudović]] | league = [[Moldovan Liga|Liga]] | season = [[2025–26 Moldovan Liga|2025–26]] | position = Liga, 2nd of 8 | current = 2026–27 FC Sheriff Tiraspol season | pattern_la1 = _adidassquadra25yb | pattern_b1 = _adidassquadra25yb | pattern_ra1 = _adidassquadra25yb | pattern_sh1 = _adidassquadra25yb | pattern_so1 = _3_stripes_black | leftarm1 = FFEF00 | body1 = FFEF00 | rightarm1 = FFEF00 | shorts1 = FFEF00 | socks1 = FFEF00 | pattern_la2 = _adidastirom23b | pattern_b2 = _adidastirom23b | pattern_ra2 = _adidastirom23b | pattern_sh2 = _adidastirol23b | pattern_so2 = _3_stripes_white | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 000000 | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b3 = | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = | body3 = | rightarm3 = | shorts3 = | socks3 = | website = {{URL|http://fc-sheriff.com/}} }} '''Fotbal Club Sheriff Tiraspol''' ({{langx|ru|ФК Шериф Тирасполь}}), commonly known as '''Sheriff Tiraspol''' or simply '''Sheriff''', is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Tiraspol]], a city located in the [[List of states with limited recognition|unrecognised breakaway state]] of [[Transnistria]], that plays in the [[Moldovan Liga]], the top tier of Moldovan football. Founded in 1997 as ''Tiras Tiraspol'' and rebranded the following year as ''Sheriff'', it quickly established itself within [[Football in Moldova|Moldovan football]]. "The Wasps" recorded their debut in the [[Moldovan National Division|first league]] in the [[1998–99 Moldovan National Division|1998–99 season]], when they also won their first trophy, the [[Moldovan Cup]]. They have since amassed 21 championship titles, 13 Cups, and seven [[Moldovan Super Cup|Super Cups]]–all competition records. On the [[UEFA competitions|European stage]], Sheriff has reached the group stage of the [[UEFA Europa League]] on six occasions and in 2021 became the first ever Moldovan side to reach the group stages of the [[2021–22 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]], where they would go on to notch a win against eventual champions [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] before eventually exiting the competition. The club takes its current name from its main sponsor, [[Sheriff (company)|Sheriff]], a company which operates nearly all forms of profitable private industries in Transnistria. Both FC Sheriff and the parent company Sheriff are considered intimately aligned with [[Transnistria conflict|Transnistrian separatism]] and pro-Russian sympathies. Home games are played in yellow and black [[Kit (association football)|kits]] at the [[Sheriff Arena]], to which the club moved in 2002 and which has a capacity of 12,746."}}
